program.name: Five-Split 60 Tempo II
program.subject: Signature
program.blurb: Five-Split 60 Tempo, one level harder: every day starts where the original's Level II did, with the newer moves in the mix.
program.about: The same five-day body-part split as Five-Split 60: chest, back, legs, shoulders and arms, then abs and cardio. Everything is straight sets, with abs to close. Five-Split 60 adds reps and then weight; this one keeps the weights and slows down, with a three-second lowering on every move that can take it at Levels II and III. This II is the same program one level up, with the newest moves in the mix, and its Level III adds a set where the day has room.
program.split: Chest / back / legs / shoulders & arms / abs & cardio
